thinking:
悦容美发美容 (Yuerong Hair & Beauty Salon) in Guangzhou.
Women and men aged 20-45.
Haircuts, hair coloring, skin care.
Home, Services (with prices), About Team, Appointment (booking form).
Get users to book an appointment.
Professional, deployable static site.
Simplified Chinese.
Multiple files (index.html, others), relative links, internal CSS/JS, no remote assets, desktop-first (1440px) but responsive, no AI mentions.

    *   *Color Palette:* Elegant, clean. Maybe soft gold, cream, and charcoal or a modern rose gold/white theme. Let's go with a sophisticated "Modern Luxury" feel: #fdfbf7 (background), #b89b72 (accent gold), #333 (text).
    *   *Navigation:* Simple top bar.
    *   *Layout:* Hero section on Home, Grid for services, Profile cards for team.

    *   *index.html (Home):* Welcome message, highlights of services, testimonials, CTA to book.
    *   *services.html (Services):* Categorized price list (Hair, Skin, Packages).
    *   *team.html (About Team):* Profiles of stylists (Experience, Specialty).
    *   *booking.html (Appointment):* Form with name, phone, service selection, date/time.

    *   *Home:* "悦容美发美容 - 打造您的专属魅力" (Create your exclusive charm). Focus on the Guangzhou location.
    *   *Services:*
        *   Hair: 基础剪发 (Basic cut), 时尚染发 (Trendy color), 数字化烫发 (Digital perm).
        *   Skin: 深层补水 (Deep hydration), 亮肤护理 (Brightening care), 抗衰面部按摩 (Anti-aging facial).
    *   *Team:* Stylists like "陈老师" (Master Chen), "Linda", "Kevin".
    *   *Booking:* Simple form fields.

    *   Ensure all links are relative.
    *   Embed CSS in `<style>` tags.
    *   Use a clean sans-serif font stack.
    *   Check the "no remote assets" rule (no Google Fonts, no CDN JS).
